description:
Music video for the song Butai ni Tatte by YOASOBI.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as NHK's Sport Theme for 2024. There exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on August 6, 2024 and an English version of the song titled "On the Stage" by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on August 11, 2024.
